title: Add JsonPropertyName attributes to all model classes
description:
P1 finding (recalibrated from P2 by council). MemorySmith.Core/Models/ has no [JsonPropertyName] attributes on any model classes. With System.Text.Json default PascalCase serialization and known camelCase drift issues in the project, adding explicit attributes will lock the serialization contract and prevent future breakage.

Files: MemorySmith.Core/Models/*.cs
Confidence: 85%
Council notes: Recalibrated from P2 to P1 because the project has known camelCase drift and should lock the contract with explicit attributes.
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md, council-codebase-audit-20260710.md
